title: cjk-readings@1: one tradition's readings of the shared Chinese characters
description: languages/<id>/characters/<tradition>.jsonl: kanji under japanese, hanzi under chinese, hanja under hangul. The first line is the header; every later line is one character, in teaching order. Every character must be in cjk/characters.jsonl.

language.description: The language id; must match the folder.

name.description: The tradition's English name, as a learner sees it.

notes.description: Which characters are listed, in what order, and where the readings come from, one sentence or line each.

char.description: The character, unique in the file.

roman.description: The main reading: on'yomi in katakana, pinyin, or hangul.

level.description: Kanji: JLPT level, N5 to N1.

grade.description: Kanji: the school grade it is taught in, 1 to 6, or S for secondary school.

frequency.description: Kanji: rank by frequency in newspapers, 1 the most common.

pinyin.description: Hanzi: every Mandarin reading, the main one first.

hsk.description: Hanzi: the lowest HSK 3.0 level a word with the character appears at.

traditional.description: Hanzi: the traditional form, when it differs.

hangul.description: Hanja: every education reading in hangul, separated by " / ".
